-- Restore course_i18n from course_version_i18n
BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.course_version_i18n') IS NOT NULL
       AND to_regclass('public.course_i18n') IS NULL THEN
        ALTER TABLE course_version_i18n RENAME TO course_i18n;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE course_i18n
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS course_id uuid;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'course_i18n' AND column_name = 'course_version_id'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            UPDATE course_i18n ci
            SET course_id = cv.course_id
            FROM course_version cv
            WHERE ci.course_version_id = cv.id
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

DELETE FROM course_i18n WHERE course_id IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_i18n
    ALTER COLUMN course_id SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_i18n
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_version_i18n_pkey,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS course_i18n_pkey,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_version_i18n_course_version;

DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_course_version_i18n_course_version_id;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_course_version_i18n_i18n_id;

ALTER TABLE course_i18n
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS course_version_id;

ALTER TABLE course_i18n
    ADD PRIMARY KEY (course_id, i18n_id);

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'course_i18n_course_id_fkey') THEN
        ALTER TABLE course_i18n
            ADD CONSTRAINT course_i18n_course_id_fkey
            FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
    END IF;
END $$;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_i18n_course_id ON course_i18n(course_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_i18n_i18n_id ON course_i18n(i18n_id);

COMMIT;
